If every cryptocurrency is a meme-coin, what separates Bitcoin from Dogecoin?

https://t.co/6yAncrhHQK

@stonecoldpat0 @Inchhighprivate Pre-Ethereum, I don't remember much "toxicity". Litecoin, Monero, and even Dogecoin were very welcome. It was all fun and games. 

The DAO hack (fork of ETH-classic), and the Blocksize Wars got maximalism to emerge in full force. Maybe OP_RETURN was the genesis. Hmmmm.
